form.official-title: To amend title XVIII of the Social Security Act to provide for coverage of certain lymphedema compression treatment items under the Medicare program.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Lymphedema Treatment Act.

section.header: Medicare coverage of certain lymphedema compression treatment items

subsection.text: Section 1861 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395x) is amended—

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (GG), by striking and after the semicolon at the end;
in subparagraph (HH), by striking the period at the end and inserting ; and; and
by adding at the end the following new subparagraph:
lymphedema compression treatment items (as defined in subsection (lll));

paragraph.text: by adding at the end the following new subsection:

subsection.text: The term lymphedema compression treatment items means—

paragraph.text: standard and custom fitted gradient compression garments that are—

subparagraph.text: furnished on or after January 1, 2023, to an individual with a diagnosis of lymphedema for the treatment of such condition;
primarily and customarily used in the medical treatment of lymphedema, as determined by the Secretary; and

prescribed by a physician (or a physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or a clinical nurse specialist (as those terms are defined in section 1861(aa)(5)) to the extent authorized under State law); and

paragraph.text: other devices determined by the Secretary to be effective in the prevention or treatment of lymphedema.

subsection.text: The amendments made by subsection (a) shall apply to lymphedema compression treatment items furnished on or after January 1, 2023.
